In this polygon, the angles are 76° and one angle marked as x. Find x.
x = ___°
quizzes.backend_description: The diagram shows three rays extending from a common point. A red arc marks a right angle at the common point. Two angles are formed: angle p and an angle labeled 76°. Together, they make up the 90° right angle.
solution: Complementary angles have measures that add to 90°. When a right angle is divided into two adjacent angles, complementary angles are formed.
Add the measures of the complementary angles and set the sum equal to 90°. Then solve for p.
